title_zh: 汪峰：中国摇滚乐坛的代表歌手
title_en: Chinese Pop Songs (15/20): Wang Feng, a Leading Voice of Chinese Rock
note_en: 尽管…但… means "although..., (still)..." and sets up a contrast: 尽管摇滚音乐在中国一直比较小众，但他的作品...获得了很多主流听众的喜爱 "although rock has always been niche in China, his work has won many mainstream listeners." English uses either "although" or "but," never both, whereas Chinese normally pairs 尽管 (a slightly more formal 虽然) with 但 or 但是 in the second clause.
